item.title: Parish wood park pond - writing to louie french!!, 13th August
item.description:
(Writing to local MP Louie French's office for urgent escalation help. If other residents read this report and want to also send an email to Louie too. Together we can help save this pond!) Is anyone in the council going to please give this a high priority that it deserves please? This pond will no longer exist in about 1 week's time?! A wildlife CATASTROPHE for all the habitat and animals that depend on Parish Wood Pond to survive and thrive. Firstly this pond has no other source of water that fills it up! So unless the Fire Brigrade is able to urgently pump some water in it PLEASE. The algae & quality of the water has been effected by the drought. Secondly, now that it's survival is unlikely, the amount of fly tipping & rubbish in, is unreal. It desperately urgently needs for the rubbish & fly tipping to be removed! Thank you!
